text: Foster carer, little boy 6 yrs. He's had a temperature since yesterday and I'm frightened because he's new with us and I don't know what's normal for him. Between the doses of paracetamol/ibuprofen he's actually playing, drinking fine and chatting non stop. He's got a rash on his tummy tonight though. I did the glass test and it fades, goes pale under it. I keep checking it every half hour. Just need someone to tell me if I'm doing the right thing keeping him home
